passage: Arriving in the capital after months at sea, the expedition's members found that their findings had already been ______ a rival team had announced the discovery of the same strait two weeks earlier.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: The second clause explains what “anticipated” means here.
A colon introduces an explanation after a complete clause.
A comma alone splices two clauses; no punctuation runs them together; “, and,” adds a stray comma.
key: A colon can join two complete clauses when the second explains the first.
